integrity: All-dimensional quantifiers claimed here for the two-dimensional cap-slope matrix follow from exact symbolic discriminant and local Jensen arguments, not sample-based extrapolation. Numerical checks are supplementary. No independent external verification is represented.
scientific_limitations: Classical smooth mixed-fiber curvature for two unit balls in R^3 only; not nonsmooth seam curvature, other radii without rescaling, or three-or-more-ball intersections. Unindexed older matrix-convexity formulas may exist.
title: Sharp safe-slope threshold for Steiner symmetrization of two-ball lenses
